english: O Allah, You are the [source of] peace,
peace is coming from You,
peace is for You,
and to You does peace belong.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
english: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honor, above what they describe.
Peace be on the messengers.
All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
Peace be upon the Imams; the guides and well-guided.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَاءِ ٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ
english: Peace be upon all Prophets, Messengers, and angels of Allah.
transliteration: alssalamu `ala jami`i anbya'i allahi wa rusulihi wa mala'ikatihi

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَىٰ عِبَادِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
english: Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
Peace be upon `Ali, the Commander of the Believers.
Peace be upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
the two chiefs of all the youth of Paradise.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ زَيْنِ ٱلْعَابِدِينَ
english: Peace be upon `Ali the son of al-Husayn, the Adornment of the Worshippers.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بَاقِرِ عِلْمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
english: Peace be upon Muhammad the son of `Ali, the splitter of the knowledge of the Prophets.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلصَّادِقِ
english: Peace be upon Ja`far the son of Muhammad, the veracious.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ٱلْكَاظِمِ
english: Peace be upon Musa the son of Ja`far, the suppressor of rage.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ ٱلرِّضَا
english: Peace be upon `Ali the son of Musa, the amiable.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْجَوَادِ
english: Peace be upon Muhammad the son of `Ali, the magnanimous.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْهَادِي
english: Peace be upon `Ali the son of Muhammad, the guide.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلزَّكِيِّ ٱلْعَسْكَرِيِّ
english: Peace be upon al-Hasan the son of `Ali, the bright and resident of `Askar.

arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُجَّةِ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱلْقَائِمِ ٱلْمَهْدِيِّ
english: Peace be upon the Argument (of Allah), the son of al-Hasan, the Assumer and the well-guided.
transliteration: alssalamu `ala alhujjati bni alhasani alqa'imi almahdiyyi

english: Blessings of Allah be upon them all.
